200.description: Customer offers and loyalty data retrieved

allOf.description: Standard response envelope used by all endpoints except getLoyaltyTierDescription

data.description: Response payload on success; error message string on failure

allOf.title: ApiResponse

data.description: Customer's available offers, loyalty balance, tier status, and redemption limits

customer_mobile.description: Customer's mobile number as stored in Qubriux

customer_email.description: Customer's email address as stored in Qubriux

loyalty_points_multiplier.description: Current earn multiplier for the customer's tier. 1.5 = 1.5× points per qualifying purchase.

loyalty_tier.description: Numeric tier level (1 = lowest configured tier)

loyalty_tier_name.description: Display name of the customer's current tier

next_loyalty_tier.description: Display name of the next tier. Null if the customer is on the highest tier.

next_loyalty_tier_entry_points.description: Points balance required to qualify for the next tier

next_loyalty_tier_order_value.description: Cumulative spend required for the next tier (spend-based programmes only)

isHighestTier.description: True when the customer is already on the programme's highest tier

totalAmountToRedeem.description: Maximum monetary value the customer can redeem from their current points balance

totalAccumulatedOrderValue.description: Customer's cumulative spend within the current tier evaluation window

max_loyalty_points.description: Maximum points the customer may redeem in a single transaction

min_loyalty_points.description: Minimum points required to initiate a redemption

max_percentage_bill_value.description: Maximum percentage of the transaction bill that may be covered by points redemption

min_percentage_bill_value.description: Minimum bill percentage that must be covered when points redemption is used

loyalty_points_bracket.description: Conversion bracket — number of points equivalent to one unit of currency

pointsToBeExpiredInXDays.description: Points expiring within the window specified by beansExpiryAfterDays in the request

firstOrderDate.description: Date of the customer's first order (ISO 8601)

tierChangeDate.description: Date when the customer last changed tier (ISO 8601)

tierMismatch.description: True if the stored tier does not match current qualification data, indicating a pending recalculation

offers.description: Active offers currently available to this customer

items.description: An offer or coupon available to the customer

offer_code.description: Unique offer code. Pass this value in couponCode when calling applyCoupon.

offer_name.description: Internal offer name as configured in the Qubriux dashboard

offerNameAlias.description: Customer-facing display name, if configured separately from the internal name

discount_value.description: Discount magnitude (monetary amount or percentage depending on discount_type)

discount_on.description: Scope of the discount (e.g. total_bill, specific_item, category)

expiryDate.description: Offer expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the offer

comment.description: Optional terms or notes attached to the offer

toApplyOnMultipleProduct.description: When true, the discount applies across multiple qualifying products in a single order

products_info.description: Products this offer applies to or is restricted to

offer_barrier.description: Conditions that must be satisfied before the offer applies (e.g. minimum order value)

items.title: Coupon

data.title: GetCustomerOfferResponse

401.description: Authentication failed. The api_key is invalid, or the JWT Bearer token is invalid or does not match the merchant context.

invalidJwt.summary: JWT token does not match merchant context

422.description: The request was well-formed but failed business rule validation (e.g. customer not found, insufficient points balance, duplicate customer).

example.data: Customer not found for the provided identifier

500.description: An unexpected server-side error occurred. Retry after a brief interval. Contact Qubriux support if the problem persists.

example.data: An internal error occurred. Please try again later.
